title: Generative agent-based modeling with actions grounded in physical, social, or digital space using Concordia

defines.name: Concordia
defines.definition: A library for constructing and running generative agent-based models in physically, socially, or digitally grounded environments.

problem: Traditional agent-based models are too abstract and limited to capture the complexity of real social and digital interactions, and there is no flexible framework for grounded generative simulations.
